This is a real, honest difference from the scenario's original expectation, caused by using rendered-text extraction rather than raw textContent/HTML, not by any content filtering.

No `eval` CLI command exists, so the CLI surface has no way to fetch document.documentElement.outerHTML.length for a true raw-HTML comparison (unlike the SDK/MCP drivers, which can call eval() directly). Reporting the snap listing's own character count as the CLI-surface half of this measurement; the raw-HTML side is a genuine CLI gap, not a fabricated number.
